verses.ar: أَنَا هُوَ ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلَّذِي رأَى مَذَلَّةً بِقَضِيبِ سَخَطِهِ.
verses.kjv: I [am] the man [that] hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.web: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.he: אֲנִ֤י הַגֶּ֙בֶר֙ רָאָ֣ה עֳנִ֔י בְּשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: قَادَنِي وَسَيَّرَنِي فِي ٱلظَّلَامِ وَلَا نُورَ.
verses.kjv: He hath led me, and brought [me into] darkness, but not [into] light.
verses.web: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
verses.he: אֹותִ֥י נָהַ֛ג וַיֹּלַ֖ךְ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־אֹֽור׃

verses.ar: حَقًّا إِنَّهُ يَعُودُ وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيَّ يَدَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ.
verses.kjv: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand [against me] all the day.
verses.web: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
verses.he: אַ֣ךְ בִּ֥י יָשֻׁ֛ב יַהֲפֹ֥ךְ יָדֹ֖ו כָּל־הַיֹּֽום׃ ס

verses.ar: أَبْلَى لَحْمِي وَجِلْدِي. كَسَّرَ عِظَامِي.
verses.kjv: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.web: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
verses.he: בִּלָּ֤ה בְשָׂרִי֙ וְעֹורִ֔י שִׁבַּ֖ר עַצְמֹותָֽי׃

verses.ar: بَنَى عَلَيَّ وَأَحَاطَنِي بِعَلْقَمٍ وَمَشَقَّةٍ.
verses.kjv: He hath builded against me, and compassed [me] with gall and travail.
verses.web: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
verses.he: בָּנָ֥ה עָלַ֛י וַיַּקַּ֖ף רֹ֥אשׁ וּתְלָאָֽה׃

verses.ar: أَسْكَنَنِي فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ كَمَوْتَى ٱلْقِدَمِ.
verses.kjv: He hath set me in dark places, as [they that be] dead of old.
verses.web: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
verses.he: בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּ֥ים הֹושִׁיבַ֖נִי כְּמֵתֵ֥י עֹולָֽם׃ ס

verses.ar: سَيَّجَ عَلَيَّ فَلَا أَسْتَطِيعُ ٱلْخُرُوجَ. ثَقَّلَ سِلْسِلَتِي.
verses.kjv: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.web: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
verses.he: גָּדַ֧ר בַּעֲדִ֛י וְלֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א הִכְבִּ֥יד נְחָשְׁתִּֽי׃

verses.ar: أَيْضًا حِينَ أَصْرُخُ وَأَسْتَغِيثُ يَصُدُّ صَلَاتِي.
verses.kjv: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.web: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
verses.he: גַּ֣ם כִּ֤י אֶזְעַק֙ וַאֲשַׁוֵּ֔עַ שָׂתַ֖ם תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃

verses.ar: سَيَّجَ طُرُقِي بِحِجَارَةٍ مَنْحُوتَةٍ. قَلَبَ سُبُلِي.
verses.kjv: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.web: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
verses.he: גָּדַ֤ר דְּרָכַי֙ בְּגָזִ֔ית נְתִיבֹתַ֖י עִוָּֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: هُوَ لِي دُبٌّ كَامِنٌ، أَسَدٌ فِي مَخَابِىءَ.
verses.kjv: He [was] unto me [as] a bear lying in wait, [and as] a lion in secret places.
verses.web: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.
verses.he: דֹּ֣ב אֹרֵ֥ב הוּא֙ לִ֔י *אַרְיֵה (אֲרִ֖י) בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃

verses.ar: مَيَّلَ طُرُقِي وَمَزَّقَنِي. جَعَلَنِي خَرَابًا.
verses.kjv: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
verses.web: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
verses.he: דְּרָכַ֥י סֹורֵ֛ר וַֽיְפַשְּׁחֵ֖נִי שָׂמַ֥נִי שֹׁמֵֽם׃

verses.ar: مَدَّ قَوْسَهُ وَنَصَبَنِي كَغَرَضٍ لِلسَّهْمِ.
verses.kjv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.web: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.he: דָּרַ֤ךְ קַשְׁתֹּו֙ וַיַּצִּיבֵ֔נִי כַּמַּטָּרָ֖א לַחֵֽץ׃ ס

verses.ar: أَدْخَلَ فِي كُلْيَتَيَّ نِبَالَ جُعْبَتِهِ.
verses.kjv: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.web: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
verses.he: הֵבִיא֙ בְּכִלְיֹותָ֔י בְּנֵ֖י אַשְׁפָּתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: صِرْتُ ضُحْكَةً لِكُلِّ شَعْبِي، وَأُغْنِيَةً لَهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ.
verses.kjv: I was a derision to all my people; [and] their song all the day.
verses.web: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
verses.he: הָיִ֤יתִי שְּׂחֹק֙ לְכָל־עַמִּ֔י נְגִינָתָ֖ם כָּל־הַיֹּֽום׃

verses.ar: أَشْبَعَنِي مَرَائِرَ وَأَرْوَانِي أَفْسَنْتِينًا،
verses.kjv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.web: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
verses.he: הִשְׂבִּיעַ֥נִי בַמְּרֹורִ֖ים הִרְוַ֥נִי לַעֲנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: وَجَرَشَ بِٱلْحَصَى أَسْنَانِي. كَبَسَنِي بِٱلرَّمَادِ.
verses.kjv: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.web: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
verses.he: וַיַּגְרֵ֤ס בֶּֽחָצָץ֙ שִׁנָּ֔י הִכְפִּישַׁ֖נִי בָּאֵֽפֶר׃

verses.ar: وَقَدْ أَبْعَدْتَ عَنِ ٱلسَّلَامِ نَفْسِي. نَسِيتُ ٱلْخَيْرَ.
verses.kjv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.web: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
verses.he: וַתִּזְנַ֧ח מִשָּׁלֹ֛ום נַפְשִׁ֖י נָשִׁ֥יתִי טֹובָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَقُلْتُ: «بَادَتْ ثِقَتِي وَرَجَائِي مِنَ ٱلرَّبِّ».
verses.kjv: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
verses.web: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”
verses.he: וָאֹמַר֙ אָבַ֣ד נִצְחִ֔י וְתֹוחַלְתִּ֖י מֵיְהוָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: ذِكْرُ مَذَلَّتِي وَتَيَهَانِي أَفْسَنْتِينٌ وَعَلْقَمٌ.
verses.kjv: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.web: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
verses.he: זְכָר־עָנְיִ֥י וּמְרוּדִ֖י לַעֲנָ֥ה וָרֹֽאשׁ׃

verses.ar: ذِكْرًا تَذْكُرُ نَفْسِي وَتَنْحَنِي فِيَّ.
verses.kjv: My soul hath [them] still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.web: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
verses.he: זָכֹ֣ור תִּזְכֹּ֔ור *וְתָשִׁיחַ (וְתָשֹׁ֥וחַ) עָלַ֖י נַפְשִֽׁי׃

verses.ar: أُرَدِّدُ هَذَا فِي قَلْبِي، مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ أَرْجُو:
verses.kjv: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.web: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
verses.he: זֹ֛את אָשִׁ֥יב אֶל־לִבִּ֖י עַל־כֵּ֥ן אֹוחִֽיל׃ ס

verses.ar: إِنَّهُ مِنْ إِحْسَانَاتِ ٱلرَّبِّ أَنَّنَا لَمْ نَفْنَ، لِأَنَّ مَرَاحِمَهُ لَا تَزُولُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ [It is of] the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.web: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
verses.he: חַֽסְדֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ כִּ֣י לֹא־תָ֔מְנוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־כָל֖וּ רַחֲמָֽיו׃

verses.ar: هِيَ جَدِيدَةٌ فِي كُلِّ صَبَاحٍ. كَثِيرَةٌ أَمَانَتُكَ.
verses.kjv: [They are] new every morning: great [is] thy faithfulness.
verses.web: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
verses.he: חֲדָשִׁים֙ לַבְּקָרִ֔ים רַבָּ֖ה אֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: نَصِيبِي هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ، قَالَتْ نَفْسِي، مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ أَرْجُوهُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.web: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
verses.he: חֶלְקִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אָמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔י עַל־כֵּ֖ן אֹוחִ֥יל לֹֽו׃ ס

verses.ar: طَيِّبٌ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِلَّذِينَ يَتَرَجَّوْنَهُ، لِلنَّفْسِ ٱلَّتِي تَطْلُبُهُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] good unto them that wait for him, to the soul [that] seeketh him.
verses.web: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
verses.he: טֹ֤וב יְהוָה֙ לְקֹוָ֔ו לְנֶ֖פֶשׁ תִּדְרְשֶֽׁנּוּ׃

verses.ar: جَيِّدٌ أَنْ يَنْتَظِرَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ وَيَتَوَقَّعَ بِسُكُوتٍ خَلَاصَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: [It is] good that [a man] should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.web: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
verses.he: טֹ֤וב וְיָחִיל֙ וְדוּמָ֔ם לִתְשׁוּעַ֖ת יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: جَيِّدٌ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَحْمِلَ ٱلنِّيرَ فِي صِبَاهُ.
verses.kjv: [It is] good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.web: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.he: טֹ֣וב לַגֶּ֔בֶר כִּֽי־יִשָּׂ֥א עֹ֖ל בִּנְעוּרָֽיו׃ ס

verses.ar: يَجْلِسُ وَحْدَهُ وَيَسْكُتُ، لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ وَضَعَهُ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne [it] upon him.
verses.web: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
verses.he: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּדָד֙ וְיִדֹּ֔ם כִּ֥י נָטַ֖ל עָלָֽיו׃

verses.ar: يَجْعَلُ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ فَمَهُ لَعَلَّهُ يُوجَدُ رَجَاءٌ.
verses.kjv: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.web: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
verses.he: יִתֵּ֤ן בֶּֽעָפָר֙ פִּ֔יהוּ אוּלַ֖י יֵ֥שׁ תִּקְוָֽה׃

verses.ar: يُعْطِي خَدَّهُ لِضَارِبِهِ. يَشْبَعُ عَارًا.
verses.kjv: He giveth [his] cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.web: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
verses.he: יִתֵּ֧ן לְמַכֵּ֛הוּ לֶ֖חִי יִשְׂבַּ֥ע בְּחֶרְפָּֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلسَّيِّدَ لَا يَرْفُضُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.web: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
verses.he: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א יִזְנַ֛ח לְעֹולָ֖ם אֲדֹנָֽי׃

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُ وَلَوْ أَحْزَنَ يَرْحَمُ حَسَبَ كَثْرَةِ مَرَاحِمِهِ.
verses.kjv: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.web: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
verses.he: כִּ֣י אִם־הֹוגָ֔ה וְרִחַ֖ם כְּרֹ֥ב *חַסְדֹּו (חֲסָדָֽיו)׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَا يُذِلُّ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ، وَلَا يُحْزِنُ بَنِي ٱلْإِنْسَانِ.
verses.kjv: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.web: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
verses.he: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עִנָּה֙ מִלִּבֹּ֔ו וַיַּגֶּ֖ה בְּנֵי־אִֽישׁ׃ ס

verses.ar: أَنْ يَدُوسَ أَحَدٌ تَحْتَ رِجْلَيْهِ كُلَّ أَسْرَى ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.web: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.he: לְדַכֵּא֙ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל אֲסִ֥ירֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: أَنْ يُحَرِّفَ حَقَّ ٱلرَّجُلِ أَمَامَ وَجْهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ،
verses.kjv: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
verses.web: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
verses.he: לְהַטֹּות֙ מִשְׁפַּט־גָּ֔בֶר נֶ֖גֶד פְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֹֽון׃

verses.ar: أَنْ يَقْلِبَ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ فِي دَعْوَاهُ. ٱلسَّيِّدُ لَا يَرَى!
verses.kjv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.web: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
verses.he: לְעַוֵּ֤ת אָדָם֙ בְּרִיבֹ֔ו אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א רָאָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: مَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَقُولُ فَيَكُونَ وَٱلرَّبُّ لَمْ يَأْمُرْ؟
verses.kjv: ¶ Who [is] he [that] saith, and it cometh to pass, [when] the Lord commandeth [it] not?
verses.web: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
verses.he: מִ֣י זֶ֤ה אָמַר֙ וַתֶּ֔הִי אֲדֹנָ֖י לֹ֥א צִוָּֽה׃

verses.ar: مِنْ فَمِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ أَلَا تَخْرُجُ ٱلشُّرُورُ وَٱلْخَيْرُ؟
verses.kjv: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.web: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
verses.he: מִפִּ֤י עֶלְיֹון֙ לֹ֣א תֵצֵ֔א הָרָעֹ֖ות וְהַטֹּֽוב׃

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا يَشْتَكِي ٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلْحَيُّ، ٱلرَّجُلُ مِنْ قِصَاصِ خَطَايَاهُ؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.web: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.he: מַה־יִּתְאֹונֵן֙ אָדָ֣ם חָ֔י גֶּ֖בֶר עַל־*חֶטְאֹו (חֲטָאָֽיו)׃ ס

verses.ar: لِنَفْحَصْ طُرُقَنَا وَنَمْتَحِنْهَا وَنَرْجِعْ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.web: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
verses.he: נַחְפְּשָׂ֤ה דְרָכֵ֙ינוּ֙ וְֽנַחְקֹ֔רָה וְנָשׁ֖וּבָה עַד־יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: لِنَرْفَعْ قُلُوبَنَا وَأَيْدِيَنَا إِلَى ٱللهِ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ:
verses.kjv: Let us lift up our heart with [our] hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.web: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
verses.he: נִשָּׂ֤א לְבָבֵ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־כַּפָּ֔יִם אֶל־אֵ֖ל בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: «نَحْنُ أَذْنَبْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا. أَنْتَ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ.
verses.kjv: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.web: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
verses.he: נַ֤חְנוּ פָשַׁ֙עְנוּ֙ וּמָרִ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א סָלָֽחְתָּ׃ ס

verses.ar: ٱلْتَحَفْتَ بِٱلْغَضَبِ وَطَرَدْتَنَا. قَتَلْتَ وَلَمْ تَشْفِقْ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.web: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
verses.he: סַכֹּ֤תָה בָאַף֙ וַֽתִּרְדְּפֵ֔נוּ הָרַ֖גְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ׃

verses.ar: ٱلْتَحَفْتَ بِٱلسَّحَابِ حَتَّى لَا تَنْفُذَ ٱلصَّلَاةُ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that [our] prayer should not pass through.
verses.web: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
verses.he: סַכֹּ֤ותָה בֶֽעָנָן֙ לָ֔ךְ מֵעֲבֹ֖ור תְּפִלָּֽה׃

verses.ar: جَعَلْتَنَا وَسَخًا وَكَرْهًا فِي وَسَطِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast made us [as] the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.web: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
verses.he: סְחִ֧י וּמָאֹ֛וס תְּשִׂימֵ֖נוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָעַמִּֽים׃ ס

verses.ar: فَتَحَ كُلُّ أَعْدَائِنَا أَفْوَاهَهُمْ عَلَيْنَا.
verses.kjv: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.web: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
verses.he: פָּצ֥וּ עָלֵ֛ינוּ פִּיהֶ֖ם כָּל־אֹיְבֵֽינוּ׃

verses.ar: صَارَ عَلَيْنَا خَوْفٌ وَرُعْبٌ، هَلَاكٌ وَسَحْقٌ».
verses.kjv: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.web: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
verses.he: פַּ֧חַד וָפַ֛חַת הָ֥יָה לָ֖נוּ הַשֵּׁ֥את וְהַשָּֽׁבֶר׃

verses.ar: سَكَبَتْ عَيْنَايَ يَنَابِيعَ مَاءٍ عَلَى سَحْقِ بِنْتِ شَعْبِي.
verses.kjv: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.web: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.he: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֙יִם֙ תֵּרַ֣ד עֵינִ֔י עַל־שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־עַמִּֽי׃ ס

verses.ar: عَيْنِي تَسْكُبُ وَلَا تَكُفُّ بِلَا ٱنْقِطَاعٍ
verses.kjv: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
verses.web: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
verses.he: עֵינִ֧י נִגְּרָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א תִדְמֶ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין הֲפֻגֹֽות׃

verses.ar: حَتَّى يُشْرِفَ وَيَنْظُرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ.
verses.kjv: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.web: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.
verses.he: עַד־יַשְׁקִ֣יף וְיֵ֔רֶא יְהוָ֖ה מִשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: عَيْنِي تُؤَثِّرُ فِي نَفْسِي لِأَجْلِ كُلِّ بَنَاتِ مَدِينَتِي.
verses.kjv: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.web: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.he: עֵינִי֙ עֹֽולְלָ֣ה לְנַפְשִׁ֔י מִכֹּ֖ל בְּנֹ֥ות עִירִֽי׃ ס

verses.ar: قَدِ ٱصْطَادَتْنِي أَعْدَائِي كَعُصْفُورٍ بِلَا سَبَبٍ.
verses.kjv: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.web: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
verses.he: צֹ֥וד צָד֛וּנִי כַּצִּפֹּ֖ור אֹיְבַ֥י חִנָּֽם׃

verses.ar: قَرَضُوا فِي ٱلْجُبِّ حَيَاتِي وَأَلْقَوْا عَلَيَّ حِجَارَةً.
verses.kjv: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.web: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
verses.he: צָֽמְת֤וּ בַבֹּור֙ חַיָּ֔י וַיַּדּוּ־אֶ֖בֶן בִּֽי׃

verses.ar: طَفَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِي. قُلْتُ: «قَدْ قُرِضْتُ!».
verses.kjv: Waters flowed over mine head; [then] I said, I am cut off.
verses.web: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
verses.he: צָֽפוּ־מַ֥יִם עַל־רֹאשִׁ֖י אָמַ֥רְתִּי נִגְזָֽרְתִּי׃ ס

verses.ar: دَعَوْتُ بِٱسْمِكَ يَارَبُّ مِنَ ٱلْجُبِّ ٱلْأَسْفَلِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
verses.web: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
verses.he: קָרָ֤אתִי שִׁמְךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִבֹּ֖ור תַּחְתִּיֹּֽות׃

verses.ar: لِصَوْتِي سَمِعْتَ: «لَا تَسْتُرْ أُذُنَكَ عَنْ زَفْرَتِي، عَنْ صِيَاحِي».
verses.kjv: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.web: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
verses.he: קֹולִ֖י שָׁמָ֑עְתָּ אַל־תַּעְלֵ֧ם אָזְנְךָ֛ לְרַוְחָתִ֖י לְשַׁוְעָתִֽי׃

verses.ar: دَنَوْتَ يَوْمَ دَعَوْتُكَ. قُلْتَ: «لَا تَخَفْ!».
verses.kjv: Thou drewest near in the day [that] I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.web: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
verses.he: קָרַ֙בְתָּ֙ בְּיֹ֣ום אֶקְרָאֶ֔ךָּ אָמַ֖רְתָּ אַל־תִּירָֽא׃ ס

verses.ar: خَاصَمْتَ يَا سَيِّدُ خُصُومَاتِ نَفْسِي. فَكَكْتَ حَيَاتِي.
verses.kjv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.web: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
verses.he: רַ֧בְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֛י רִיבֵ֥י נַפְשִׁ֖י גָּאַ֥לְתָּ חַיָּֽי׃

verses.ar: رَأَيْتَ يَارَبُّ ظُلْمِي. أَقِمْ دَعْوَايَ.
verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
verses.web: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
verses.he: רָאִ֤יתָה יְהוָה֙ עַוָּ֣תָתִ֔י שָׁפְטָ֖ה מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃

verses.ar: رَأَيْتَ كُلَّ نَقْمَتِهِمْ، كُلَّ أَفْكَارِهِمْ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast seen all their vengeance [and] all their imaginations against me.
verses.web: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
verses.he: רָאִ֙יתָה֙ כָּל־נִקְמָתָ֔ם כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃ ס

verses.ar: سَمِعْتَ تَعْيِيرَهُمْ يَارَبُّ، كُلَّ أَفْكَارِهِمْ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, [and] all their imaginations against me;
verses.web: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their plans against me,
verses.he: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתָם֙ יְהוָ֔ה כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖ם עָלָֽי׃

verses.ar: كَلَامُ مُقَاوِمِيَّ وَمُؤَامَرَتُهُمْ عَلَيَّ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ.
verses.kjv: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.web: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
verses.he: שִׂפְתֵ֤י קָמַי֙ וְהֶגְיֹונָ֔ם עָלַ֖י כָּל־הַיֹּֽום׃

verses.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى جُلُوسِهِمْ وَوُقُوفِهِمْ، أَنَا أُغْنِيَتُهُمْ!
verses.kjv: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I [am] their musick.
verses.web: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
verses.he: שִׁבְתָּ֤ם וְקִֽימָתָם֙ הַבִּ֔יטָה אֲנִ֖י מַנְגִּינָתָֽם׃ ס

verses.ar: رُدَّ لَهُمْ جَزَاءً يَارَبُّ حَسَبَ عَمَلِ أَيَادِيهِمْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
verses.web: You will pay them back, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.
verses.he: תָּשִׁ֨יב לָהֶ֥ם גְּמ֛וּל יְהוָ֖ה כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: أَعْطِهِمْ غِشَاوَةَ قَلْبٍ، لَعْنَتَكَ لَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.web: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
verses.he: תִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ מְגִנַּת־לֵ֔ב תַּאֲלָֽתְךָ֖ לָהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: اِتْبَعْ بِٱلْغَضَبِ وَأَهْلِكْهُمْ مِنْ تَحْتِ سَمَاوَاتِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
verses.web: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
verses.he: תִּרְדֹּ֤ף בְּאַף֙ וְתַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת שְׁמֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ פ
